newsitem.title: USA: Rare Shaker drawings found in frame.
newsitem.headline: Rare Shaker drawings found in frame.

text.p: A couple who likes to buy old frames cheap at garage sales appears to have hit the jackpot -- a frame they bought secretly contained two rare watercolor drawings by members of the 19th Century Shaker religious sect could bring in more than $300,000.
Sotheby's auction house said Wednesday that it will sell the drawings, Hannah Cohoon's "Tree of Light" and Polly Collins' "Gift Drawing," at an auction next January 19.

Sotheby's declined to identify the couple other than to say they live in New England and bought an old frame to restore with a print of an English hunt scene. After ignoring the frame for a year, they began work on restoring and discovered the drawings hidden inside.
The Shakers were a 19th Century spinoff of Quakers who led celibate lives and were famed for their furniture.
